name: Zen Technologies Ltd
business_description: Zen Technologies Ltd designs, develops, and manufactures combat training and counter-drone solutions primarily for defense and security forces. The company generates revenue by supplying these advanced simulation and security systems to armed forces, police, and paramilitary organizations.
input_sensitivity: Key cost drivers include electronic components, specialized hardware, software development costs, and skilled engineering labor.
output_note: Indian Armed Forces (Army, Navy, Air Force), paramilitary, and foreign defence agencies directly pay Zen Technologies for combat training simulators and counter-drone systems. Government/PSU procurement and export sales are both within the same defence sector.
